meta.name: lsp
meta.description: Use when Codex needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks in the current workspace.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编辑器中获取代码诊断、定义跳转和引用查找
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码编辑器中快速定位定义、引用或检查重命名安全
copy.tagline_en: Get language diagnostics, definitions, references, and rename safety in your editor
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick access to definitions, references, and rename safety in your code editor

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 可通过 lsp 工具调用语言服务器：检查文件或目录的诊断报错、跳转到符号定义、查找工作区引用、检查重命名是否安全等，产出的是这些工具返回的诊断与符号信息。
howto.when: 当 Claude 在当前工作区需要语言服务器能力（诊断、定义、引用等），或做重命名安全检查时触发。若诊断提示缺少语言服务器，应先调用 lsp.status 查看。

say.text: 用 lsp 检查 src/index.ts 的报错
找出 foo 这个函数在整个工作区的引用
把这个文件里的 Bar 重命名为 Baz

howto.what_en: With this skill Claude can call the lsp tools to query language servers: check diagnostics for a file or directory, go to a definition, find workspace references, inspect symbols, and verify a rename is safe before applying it.
howto.when_en: Triggers when Claude needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, or rename safety checks in the workspace. If a language server is missing, use lsp.status first.

say_en.text: Use lsp to check diagnostics for src/index.ts
Find all references of the function foo across the workspace
Rename Bar to Baz in this file
